title: Four benchmark advertisements — scriptwriting mechanism analysis
source_verification: Not independently watched; specific descriptions are user/Gemini-supplied, not verified facts

candidate_matches.title: The Election / Bus Seating Ad
observations: Crowded transit or political seating scene
External pressure fails to separate people
instructions: Start from a visible social constraint, not an adhesive claim
Escalate the physical test and hold a reaction beat
Reveal product causality only when audience can infer it
cautions: Description merges election and bus executions; precise asset identity unresolved
No independently verified footage, duration, shot types or sound

candidate_matches.title: Rahul Dravid — Indiranagar Ka Gunda
observations: Respected public figure reportedly behaves in exaggerated road rage
Traffic chaos contrasts with calm pitch delivery
Brand links the sketch to credit card rewards
instructions: Write behaviour contradicting that expectation, with rising specificity
Pivot into product proposition without losing message clarity
cautions: Celebrity behaviour and chronology are Gemini/user-reported, not video-verified
Do not rely on celebrity fame as the only joke

candidate_matches.title: Holi / Daag Acche Hain
observations: Child reportedly protects another during Holi
Physical staining is reinterpreted as kindness
Sparse dialogue and protective action carry emotion
Brand philosophy resolves the apparent contradiction
instructions: Identify the negative category symbol and a credible human act that redefines it
Show cost before revealing benevolent motive
End on a human consequence, not a moralising explanation
cautions: Precise plot details and child roles not independently verified
Do not trivialise actual risk or financial hardship

candidate_matches.title: The Force — Darth Vader Kid
observations: Costumed child repeatedly attempts telekinetic gestures
Series of failures establishes a visual rule
Car reacts through adult-operated remote action
Final reveal reframes the child's perceived success
instructions: Design the recontextualising product payoff first
Plant clear repeated attempts that make the final success surprising
Preserve first-view comprehension of what the product actually does
cautions: Original commercial length and any 30-second cut not verified
Technical description of the vehicle feature must be checked before reuse
